description: Solana AI Kit — pre-deploy gate. Blocks mainnet program operations unless the command is prefixed with CONFIRM_MAINNET=1. Run /hooks in Codex to review and trust it.

hooks.command: R="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; S="$R/.claude/bin/hooks/pre-deploy.sh"; if [ ! -r "$S" ]; then echo "pre-deploy gate missing ($S) — refusing to run deploy commands" >&2; exit 2; fi; exec bash "$S"
